time.desc: National Y Agency K launched an investigation into the company for accounting violations, the stock price plummeted, and analysts sharply lowered their ratings and target prices.
The company formally implemented a stock split plan, splitting each share into multiple shares to enhance liquidity.
Law firm files securities class action lawsuit on behalf of investors alleging false reporting of financial data and failure to disclose related-party transactions
The original audit agency officially resigned as public auditor, questioning the independence of the company's financial statements and management.

The original audit agency submitted a resignation letter, saying that the company's financial reports were too suspicious, that it no longer relied on management and audit committee statements, and warned about the CEO's influence on the board of directors.
The company disclosed details of the auditor's resignation. The stock price plummeted by nearly half in two days, and the market value fell below the threshold of important indexes.
The company submitted a document disclosing the resignation of the auditor, clearly stating that it disagreed with the reasons for the resignation and had started the selection of a new auditor.
The company disclosed the third revision of the loan agreement, extending the period for providing audited financial documents and adding a minimum unlimited cash clause

The company failed to clarify the submission time of the annual report, the stock price plummeted, and investment banks significantly lowered their ratings and target prices.
The company announced that it would be unable to submit its quarterly report on time and lowered its performance expectations, facing severe pressure to delist.
The company submitted a compliance plan to the exchange and hired a new auditor, and the stock price rebounded sharply.
The company hired a member firm of a large global accounting network as a new independent auditor, and the stock price further surged by more than 20% after the market closed.

The company received a non-compliance notification letter from the exchange, confirming that the delay in submitting annual and quarterly reports violated listing rules, but the trading status of ordinary shares was not affected for the time being.
Analysts rated the hiring of a new auditor as a major positive development, and the company's stock price rebounded nearly 80% in a single week.
The company's stock price rose by more than 30% in a single day, but it is still down by about 75% from the historical high during the year.
The exchange approved the extension of the listing period to a specified date and required the company to submit overdue annual and quarterly reports before that.

The special committee announced its final investigation results and determined that there was no fraud or misconduct by management and the board of directors, and there was no need to restate historical financial reports.
The Board of Directors adopted the recommendations of the Special Committee, appointed a new Chief Accounting Officer and approved transition arrangements for the Chief Financial Officer.
The company's stock price rose by about 30% in a single day as the investigation results were revealed.

The exchange officially approved the company's application for an extension to submit financial documents, and the stock will continue to be listed during the period.
